description: Creates a new task in Salesforce to track activities, to-dos, and follow-ups related to contacts, leads, or other records. Ensure who_id, what_id, and owner_id reference existing records before calling; invalid IDs cause silent linkage failures or validation errors.

activity_date.description: Due date for the task in YYYY-MM-DD format. Do not use full datetimes or natural-language strings like 'yesterday'; only YYYY-MM-DD is accepted.
activity_date.human_parameter_description: When the task should be completed, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Set a date to keep the task on schedule.
activity_date.title: Activity Date

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Priority_Level__c': 'Critical').
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Add any custom fields specific to your Salesforce org. Use the API name of each field (usually ending in '__c') as the key, and set its value.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the task.
examples: Follow up on pricing questions from last meeting
Send updated proposal with discount options
description.human_parameter_description: Any notes or details that explain what needs to be done. Include context or next steps to make the task clear.
description.title: Description

is_reminder_set.description: Whether to set a reminder for this task.
is_reminder_set.human_parameter_description: Turn this on if you want Salesforce to remind you about the task. You'll be prompted at the reminder time you set.
is_reminder_set.title: Is Reminder Set

owner_id.description: ID of the user who owns the task. Defaults to current user if not specified.
owner_id.human_parameter_description: Who should be responsible for this task. Leave blank to assign it to yourself, or enter another user's Salesforce ID.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

priority.human_parameter_description: How important the task is compared to other work. Use this to signal urgency.
priority.title: Priority

reminder_date_time.description: Date and time for the reminder in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Required if is_reminder_set is true. Interpreted according to org/user timezone, not UTC.
reminder_date_time.human_parameter_description: When the reminder should pop up, in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS format. Required only if you enable reminders.
reminder_date_time.title: Reminder Date Time

status.description: Status of the task. Must be a valid picklist value; arbitrary strings trigger validation errors.
status.human_parameter_description: How far along the task is. Choose the current state so others know its progress.
status.title: Status

subject.human_parameter_description: The short title of the task you want to create. Make it clear so you can quickly recognize what needs to be done.
subject.title: Subject

what_id.description: ID of the related record (Account, Opportunity, Case, etc.) this task is associated with. Accepts Account IDs (prefix '001'), Opportunity IDs (prefix '006'), Case IDs (prefix '500'), and other business object IDs.
what_id.human_parameter_description: The related record you want to associate with this task, like an account, opportunity, or case. Linking it helps keep the task in the right context.
what_id.title: What Id

who_id.description: ID of the Contact or Lead this task is associated with. Only accepts Contact IDs (prefix '003') or Lead IDs (prefix '00Q'). Do NOT use Account/Opportunity/Case IDs here; use what_id for those. Swapping who_id and what_id creates orphaned tasks that won't appear on contact/lead timelines. Accepts only a single ID; create separate task records for multiple contacts.
who_id.human_parameter_description: The contact or lead this task is about. Provide their Salesforce ID if you want the task tied to a specific person.
who_id.title: Who Id

name: create_task

CreateTaskResponse.description: Response from Salesforce REST API when creating a Task object.

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array when success is true. Contains one or more error objects when success is false.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The unique Salesforce record ID of the newly created Task (15 or 18 character ID). Only present when success is true.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the API call was successful. Returns true if the Task was created successfully, false otherwise.
success.title: Success

CreateTaskResponse.title: CreateTaskResponse

TaskError.description: Error object returned by Salesforce REST API when Task creation fails.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the type of error (e.g., REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION, MALFORMED_ID, INVALID_FIELD).
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field API names that caused or are related to the error. Empty array or omitted if the error is not field-specific.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error description explaining what went wrong.
message.title: Message

TaskError.title: TaskError
